message: The other day, I decided to gather my family for a little emergency preparedness chat. You know, just to make sure we had a plan in place. Well, halfway through my passionate speech about go-bags and water supply, my grandson piped up and asked if we could just keep the snacks in our go-bags instead! 🍪 It made me chuckle, but it also reminded me that being prepared doesn’t have to feel heavy. Sometimes, it’s about finding a balance between practicality and a little humor. What would you pack for an emergency snack?
